summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K reporting that it deposited $50,000 into its trust account to extend its deadline to complete an initial business combination by one month from June 22, 2026 to July 22, 2026. The extension fee was split equally between Sponsor Hercules Capital Management VII Corp and target WISeSat.Space Corp., pursuant to a November 9, 2025 business combination agreement. The filing also notes issuance of an unsecured promissory note, though details are truncated. This is a routine SPAC extension update, not a standalone special situation.
